label: Fetch to Storage
description: Download a file from a URL into storage and emit its stored-file reference; bytes stream straight to storage, so large files are fine. With `scope: project` and an `identity` (a source label like `docs:invoice-42`), a later fetch of the same identity answers the stored file and downloads nothing. For a file the run already holds in storage, use KeepFile instead.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: Stored filename; defaults to the URL's last path segment.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Store in
inputs.description: `execution`: only this run can read it. `project`: every later run can.

inputs.name: ttl_days
inputs.label: Keep for (days, 0 = forever)
inputs.description: Lifetime since last access (any read, download or presign resets it); 0 never expires. Empty: an execution file is swept soon after its run, a project file lives until deleted.

inputs.name: identity
inputs.label: Identity
inputs.description: Stable `<source>:<id>` label of what this is a copy of; a fetch whose identity is already stored in the scope reuses that file. Empty for a one-off.

then.message: FetchToStorage '{id}' has a `url` that is not a web address. Start it with http:// or https://.
